11:30 a.m. – Finance Executive Conference, 1th Floor

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the July 27, 2020, meeting.

  2. Black and White Emergency Vehicles – Executive session to discuss recommend
  payment for services provided to the Fleet Section for vehicle outfitting services.

  3. Pinnacle Petroleum – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for the use of
  gas cards for petroleum fuel.

  4. The Titan Group – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for services
  provided to the City.

elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

City of Inglewood

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  August 03, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the 1st Floor, Finance Conference Room at
11:35 a.m.:

  Members Present:  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman, City Attorney’s Office
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office

  Staff Present:  Clifton Pate, Public Works
  Micah Herd, Police

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of July 27, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. Black and White Emergency Vehicles – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  providing service to the vehicles for the Police Department in the amount of $3,572.26. Motion
  carried unanimously

3. Pinnacle Petroleum – Item not heard, pulled.

4. The Titan Group – Executive session to discuss to recommend payment for services provided to
  the City in the amount of $6,404.25. Motion carried unanimously

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 11:53 a.m. Adjournment
